title: VC Dimension & Capacity
interviewAnswer: VC dimension measures the richness of a binary hypothesis class via the largest set of points it can shatter; greater capacity usually requires more data for uniform generalization guarantees.
why: VC theory is foundational capacity theory.
intuition: A class that can realize every labeling of many points is extremely flexible.
deepDive: VC dimension yields uniform-convergence bounds for classification classes. Deep-network generalization is more nuanced, so VC dimension is a conceptual foundation rather than a practical tuning metric.
commonMistakes: Saying VC dimension equals parameter count.
Using VC dimension directly to tune deep nets.
followUps: How does VC dimension affect sample complexity?
production: Use real validation for model selection; capacity theory explains tendencies.
workedExample: Linear separators in 2D can shatter some configurations of three points but not arbitrary labelings of four.
